answer: Route every new agent through one serial inlet: a verifiable delay function seeded by the kernel of its registration hash that demands 90 seconds of strictly sequential squaring no GPU farm can parallelize. The output is pinned to the public jade anchor, and any peer re-derives it from the same kernel seed, rejecting a mismatch. One identity costs 90s of wall-clock; 1,000 sybils need 25 hours on a single machine because the inlet is serial — time is the one input a farm cannot bulk-buy or share.
